articles.title_en: The Impact of EITC on Education, Labour Market Trajectories, and Inequalities
articles.title_cn: EITC 对教育、劳动力市场轨迹和不平等的影响
articles.abstract_en: As a complement to the federal earned income tax credit (EITC), some states offer their own EITC, typically calculated as a percentage of the federal EITC. In this paper, we analyse the effect of state EITC on education using policy discontinuities at US state borders. Our estimates reveal that an increase in the state EITC leads to a statistically significant increase in the high school dropout rate. We then use a life-cycle matching model with directed search and endogenous educational choices, search intensities, hirings, hours worked, and separations to investigate the effects of EITC on the labour market in the long run and along the transitional dynamics. We show that a tax credit targeted at low-wage (and low-skilled) workers reduces the relative return to schooling, thereby generating a powerful disincentive to pursue long-term studies. In the long run, this results in an increase in the proportion of low-skilled workers in the economy, which may have important implications for employment, productivity, and income inequality. Finally, we use the model to determine the optimal design of the EITC.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为联邦所得税抵免 (EITC) 的补充，一些州提供自己的 EITC，通常按联邦 EITC 的百分比计算。在本文中，我们利用美国各州边界政策的不连续性来分析州 EITC 对教育的影响。我们的估计显示，州 EITC 的增加导致高中辍学率在统计上显着增加。然后，我们使用具有定向搜索和内生教育选择、搜索强度、招聘、工作时间和离职的生命周期匹配模型来研究 EITC 对劳动力市场的长期影响和转型动态。我们表明，针对低工资（和低技能）工人的税收抵免降低了受教育的相对回报，从而对追求长期学习产生了强大的抑制作用。从长远来看，这会导致经济中低技能工人的比例增加，这可能对就业、生产率和收入不平等产生重要影响。最后，我们使用该模型来确定 EITC 的优化设计。

articles.title_en: Globalization and the Ladder of Development: Pushed to the Top or Held at the Bottom?
articles.title_cn: 全球化与发展阶梯：推向顶端还是停留在底层？
articles.abstract_en: We study the relationship between international trade and development in a model where countries differ in their capability, goods differ in their complexity, and capability growth is a function of a country’s pattern of specialization. Theoretically, we show that it is possible for international trade to increase capability growth in all countries and, in turn, to push all countries up the development ladder. This occurs if (i) shifting employment towards more complex sectors raises capability growth and if (ii) foreign competition is tougher in less complex sectors for all countries. Empirically, we provide causal evidence consistent with (i) using the entry of countries into the World Trade Organization as an instrumental variable for other countries’ patterns of specialization. The opposite of (ii), however, holds in the data. Through the lens of our model, these two empirical observations imply dynamic welfare losses from trade that are pervasive, albeit small for the median country. The same economic forces also suggest that the emergence of China has held back capability growth for a number of African countries who are pushed away from their most-complex sectors, which China exports, and into their least-complex sectors, which China imports.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个模型中研究国际贸易与发展之间的关系，其中各国的能力不同，商品的复杂性不同，而能力增长是一个国家专业化模式的函数。从理论上讲，我们表明国际贸易有可能促进所有国家的能力增长，进而推动所有国家登上发展阶梯。如果（i）将就业转向更复杂的行业提高了能力增长，并且（ii）所有国家在不太复杂的行业中外国竞争更加激烈，就会出现这种情况。根据经验，我们提供的因果证据符合以下观点：（i）使用国家加入世界贸易组织作为其他国家专业化模式的工具变量。然而，数据却与(ii)相反。通过我们模型的视角，这些二经验观察表明，贸易带来的动态福利损失是普遍存在的，尽管对于中等国家来说规模很小。同样的经济力量还表明，中国的崛起阻碍了一些非洲国家的能力增长，这些国家被迫从中国出口的最复杂的部门转向中国进口的最简单的部门。

articles.title_en: Religion, Education, and the State
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores how state and religious providers of education compete during the nation building process. Using novel administrative data, we characterize the evolution of Indonesia’s Islamic education system and religious school choice after the introduction of mass public primary schooling in the 1970s. Funded through informal taxation, Islamic schools competed with the state by entering in the same markets. While primary enrollment shifted towards state schools, religious education increased overall as Islamic schools absorbed growing demand for secondary education. In the short run, electoral support for the secular regime weakened in markets with greater public school construction. Over the long run, Islamic schools established at this juncture are more differentiated in terms of religious curriculum, and cohorts exposed to mass public schooling as children are more invested in religion than in the national identity. Our findings offer a new perspective on the political economy of education reforms and the emergence of parallel systems of public goods provision.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了国家和宗教教育提供者在国家建设过程中如何竞争。使用新颖的行政数据，我们描述了在 1970 引入大众公立小学之后印度尼西亚伊斯兰教育体系和宗教学校选择的演变。通过非正式税收资助，伊斯兰学校通过进入相同的市场与国家竞争。虽然小学入学率转向公立学校，但随着伊斯兰学校吸收了对中等教育不断增长的需求，宗教教育总体上有所增加。短期内，随着公立学校建设规模的扩大，市场对世俗政权的选举支持减弱。从长远来看，此时建立的伊斯兰学校在宗教课程方面更加差异化，而接受大众公立学校教育的儿童对宗教的投入比对国家认同的投入更多。我们的研究结果为教育改革的政治经济学和公共产品提供平行系统的出现提供了新的视角。

articles.title_en: Does Tax-Benefit Linkage Matter for the Incidence of Payroll Taxes?
articles.title_cn: 税收与​​福利的联系对于工资税的发生率重要吗？
articles.abstract_en: We analyse earnings responses to six large payroll tax and income tax reforms in France. Our findings indicate full pass-through to workers when there is a strong and transparent link between contributions and expected benefits. In contrast, employer payroll taxes with no tax-benefit linkage exhibit limited pass-through to workers, while income tax nominally borne by employees show nearly full pass-through. Together with a meta-analysis of the literature, we interpret these results as empirical support for the long-standing hypothesis that tax-benefit linkage matters for the incidence of payroll taxes. In the absence of such linkage, our findings suggest that the individual-level incidence of payroll taxes aligns with their statutory incidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了法国对六大规模工资税和所得税改革的收入反应。我们的研究结果表明，当捐款和预期收益之间存在牢固且透明的联系时，就会完全传递给工人。相比之下，没有税收福利联系的雇主工资税对工人的转嫁有限，而名义上由雇员承担的所得税几乎完全转嫁。结合对文献的荟萃分析，我们将这些结果解释为对长期存在的假设的实证支持，即税收与福利的联系对工资税的发生率很重要。在缺乏这种联系的情况下，我们的研究结果表明，个人层面的工资税发生率与其法定发生率一致。

articles.title_en: Women in the Courtroom: Technology and Justice
articles.title_cn: 法庭上的女性：技术与正义
articles.abstract_en: Our study analyses 6 million civil judgments in China from 2014 to 2018, documenting gender disparities that disfavour female litigants. We investigate the impact of an open justice reform that mandated courts to broadcast legal proceedings live on a centralized online platform. By exploiting variations in its implementation across courts and over time and employing both difference-in-differences and Bartik IV approaches, we find that gender disparities in chances of winning decrease as broadcast intensity increases. Analysis of the textual content of judicial decisions provides further evidence that these changes in judicial outcomes stem from altered judge behaviours (i.e. attention and effort) under enhanced judicial transparency. Our results demonstrate how information technology shapes judges’ conduct, underscoring its broader potential to improve accountability in public institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们的研究分析了6至2014中国的2018百万民事判决，记录了不利于女性诉讼当事人的性别差异。我们调查了公开司法改革的影响，该改革要求法院在集中的在线平台上直播法律诉讼。通过利用不同法院和不同时间的实施差异，并采用双重差分法和 Bartik IV 方法，我们发现获胜机会的性别差异随着广播强度的增加而减少。对司法判决文本内容的分析进一步证明，司法结果的这些变化源于司法透明度增强下法官行为（即注意力和努力）的改变。我们的结果展示了信息技术如何塑造法官的行为，强调了其在改善公共机构问责制方面的更广泛潜力。

articles.title_en: Policy Diffusion and Polarization across U.S. States
articles.title_cn: 美国各州的政策扩散和两极分化
articles.abstract_en: Economists have studied the impact of numerous state laws, from welfare rules to voting ID requirements. Yet for all this policy evaluation, what do we know about policy diffusion—how these policies are introduced and spread from state to state? We present a series of facts based on a data set of 602 U.S. state policies spanning the past seven decades. First, proxies of state capacity do not predict a higher likelihood of innovating new policies, but the political leaning of the state does predict a higher likelihood of introducing partisan laws since 1990. Second, the diffusion of policies from 1950 to 2000 is best predicted by proximity—a state is more likely to adopt a policy if nearby states have already done so—as well as similarity in voter policy preferences. Third, since 2000, party alignment has become the strongest predictor of diffusion, and the speed of adoption has increased. Models of learning and correlated preferences can account for the earlier patterns, but the findings for the last two decades indicate a sharply increasing role of party control. We conclude that party polarization has emerged as a key factor recently for policy adoption, plausibly leading to a worse match between state policies and voter preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家研究了从福利规则到投票身份要求等众多州法律的影响。然而，对于所有这些政策评估，我们对政策扩散了解多少——这些政策如何在一个州之间引入和传播？我们根据过去七几十年的602美国国家政策数据集提出了一系列事实。 第一，国家能力的代理并不能预测创新新政策的更高可能性，但国家的政治倾向确实预测自1990以来引入党派法律的可能性更高。 第二，政策从1950到2000的传播最好通过邻近性来预测——如果附近的州已经采取了一项政策，那么该州更有可能采取政策——以及选民政策偏好的相似性。 第三，自2000以来，政党联盟已成为扩散的最强预测因素，并且采用的速度有所加快。学习模型和相关偏好可以解释早期的模式，但过去几十年的研究结果表明政党控制的作用急剧增强。我们的结论是，政党两极分化最近已成为政策采纳的关键因素，这可能导致国家政策与选民偏好之间的匹配度较差。

articles.title_en: Capital Requirements with Non-Bank Finance
articles.title_cn: 非银行融资的资本要求
articles.abstract_en: I quantitatively analyse the macroeconomic impacts of raising capital requirements in a model in which heterogeneous firms may choose either intermediated or direct finance. Heterogeneous banks compete with other banks and the bond market, fund loans with insured deposits and costly equity (subject to a minimum capital-to-asset ratio), and monitor borrowers. I find that tighter capital requirements reduce costly bank failures while having only small effects on key macroeconomic aggregates, and that raising capital requirements above current levels can be welfare-improving. Three main forces give rise to these results. First, even though banks cut loan supply for a given level of net worth under a tighter capital requirement, in equilibrium banks’ net worth rises to dampen this effect. Second, intense competition from the non-bank sector disciplines banks’ lending responses to tighter regulation. Third, substitution by corporate firms offsets much of the decline in debt financing associated with tighter bank loan supply. As a corollary, almost all of the modest costs associated with tighter capital requirements are concentrated within the bank-dependent non-corporate sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 我在一个模型中定量分析了提高资本要求对宏观经济的影响，在该模型中，异质企业可以选择中介融资或直接融资。异构银行与其他银行和债券市场竞争，用受保险的存款和昂贵的股权（受最低资本资产比率限制）为贷款提供资金，并监控借款人。我发现，更严格的资本要求可以减少代价高昂的银行倒闭，同时对关键宏观经济总量的影响很小，而且将资本要求提高到当前水平之上可以改善福利。 三主要力量造成了这些结果。 第一，即使银行在资本要求收紧的情况下削减给定净值水平的贷款供应，在均衡状态下，银行净值的上升会抑制这种影响。 第二，来自非银行部门的激烈竞争限制了银行对更严格监管的放贷反应。 第三，公司企业的替代抵消了与银行贷款供应收紧相关的债务融资的大部分下降。由此推论，几乎所有与资本要求收紧相关的适度成本都集中在依赖银行的非企业部门。

articles.title_en: A Dynamic Theory of Random Price Discounts
articles.title_cn: 随机价格折扣的动态理论
articles.abstract_en: A seller with commitment power sets prices over time. Risk-averse buyers arrive to the market and decide when to purchase. We show that it is optimal for the seller to choose a constant high price punctuated by occasional episodes of sequential discounts that occur at random times. This optimal price-path has the property that the price a buyer ends up paying is independent of his arrival and purchase times, and only depends on his valuation. Our theory accommodates empirical findings on the timing of discounts.
articles.abstract_cn: 具有承诺权的卖家会随着时间的推移设定价格。规避风险的买家到达市场并决定何时购买。我们表明，对于卖方来说，选择一个恒定的高价，并偶尔出现随机发生的连续折扣是最佳的。这种最优价格路径具有以下特性：买方最终支付的价格与他的到达和购买时间无关，并且仅取决于他的估价。我们的理论适应了折扣时机的实证研究结果。

articles.title_en: Brokering Votes With Information Spread Via Social Networks
articles.title_cn: 通过社交网络传播信息来促成投票
articles.abstract_en: Politicians rely on political brokers to buy votes throughout much of the developing world. We investigate how social networks facilitate these vote-buying exchanges. Our conceptual framework suggests brokers should be particularly well-placed within the network to learn about non-copartisans’ reciprocity in order to target transfers effectively. As a result, parties should recruit brokers who are central among non-copartisans. We combine village network data from brokers and citizens with broker reports of vote buying, allowing us to use broker and citizen fixed effects. We show that networks diffuse information about citizens to brokers who leverage it to target transfers. In particular, among those citizens who are not registered to their party, brokers target reciprocal citizens about whom they can learn more through their network, and these citizens are more likely to support the brokers’ party. Moreover, recruited brokers are significantly more central than other citizens among non-copartisans, but not among copartisans. These results highlight the importance of information diffusion through social networks for vote buying, broker recruitment, and ultimately for political outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 政客们依靠政治掮客在大部分发展中国家收买选票。我们研究社交网络如何促进这些买票交换。我们的概念框架表明，经纪人应该在网络中处于特别有利的位置，以了解非党派的互惠性，以便有效地瞄准转移。因此，政党应该招募在非党派人士中处于核心地位的经纪人。我们将经纪人和公民的村庄网络数据与经纪人购买选票的报告结合起来，使我们能够使用经纪人和公民的固定效应。我们表明，网络将有关公民的信息传播给经纪人，经纪人利用这些信息来进行目标转移。特别是，在那些未注册政党的公民中，经纪人瞄准了他们可以通过他们的网络了解更多信息的互惠公民，而这些公民更有可能支持经纪人的政党。此外，在非共和党人中，招募的经纪人比其他公民更重要，但在共和党人中则不然。这些结果凸显了通过社交网络传播信息对于购买选票、招募经纪人以及最终实现政治结果的重要性。

articles.title_en: A Tale of Two Networks: Common Ownership and Product Market Rivalry
articles.title_cn: 二网络的故事：共同所有权和产品市场竞争
articles.abstract_en: We study the welfare implications of the rise of common ownership in the U.S. from 1995 to 2021. We build a general equilibrium model with a hedonic demand system in which firms compete in a network game of oligopoly. Firms are connected through two large networks: the first reflects ownership overlap, the second product market rivalry. In our model, common ownership of competing firms induces unilateral incentives to soften competition and the magnitude of the common ownership effect depends on how much the two networks overlap. We estimate our model for the universe of U.S. public corporations using a combination of firm financials, investor holdings, and text-based product similarity data. We perform counterfactual calculations to evaluate how the efficiency and the distributional impact of common ownership have evolved over time. Under the assumption that firms maximise a share-weighted average of their shareholders’ income, we find that the welfare cost of common ownership, measured as the ratio of deadweight loss to total surplus, has increased about ninefold between 1995 and 2021. Under alternative assumptions about corporate governance, the deadweight loss of common ownership ranges between 3.5 and 13.2% of total surplus in 2021. The rise of common ownership has also led to a significant reallocation of surplus from consumers to producers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从1995到2021美国共同所有权兴起的福利影响。我们建立了一个具有享乐需求系统的一般均衡模型，其中企业在寡头垄断的网络博弈中竞争。企业通过二大型网络连接起来：第一反映了所有权重叠，第二产品市场竞争。在我们的模型中，竞争企业的共同所有权会引发单方面激励来软化竞争，而共同所有权效应的大小取决于二网络重叠的程度。我们结合公司财务状况、投资者持股和基于文本的产品相似性数据来估计美国上市公司的模型。我们进行反事实计算，以评估共同所有权的效率和分配影响如何随着时间的推移而演变。假设公司最大化股东收入的股票加权平均值，我们发现共同所有权的福利成本（以无谓损失与总盈余之比衡量）在1995和2021之间增加了约九倍。在有关公司治理的替代假设下，共同所有权的无谓损失范围在3.5总盈余的13.2%和2021之间。共同所有制的兴起也导致剩余从消费者到生产者的大量重新分配。

articles.title_en: The Value of Information in a Congested Fishery
articles.abstract_en: We model a fishery with potential congestion, in which firms obtain public and private signals about the location of the densest fish stock. We analytically determine the regions of parameter space where greater precision of public and/or private information increases welfare, and we examine the effects of two types of information sharing. Using high-resolution data from the world’s largest fishery, we estimate the structural model. Point estimates imply that more precise private information raises welfare, whereas more precise public information has a negligible effect on welfare. Moreover, welfare is much more sensitive to changes in the precision of private information than to changes in the precision of public information. This difference reflects the fact that public information increases congestion more than private information does. We also find empirically that a small amount of information sharing can reduce welfare, whereas more extensive information sharing raises welfare, as do information clubs.

articles.title_en: The Effect of Provider Diversity on Racial Health Disparities: Evidence from the Military
articles.title_cn: 提供者多元化对种族健康差异的影响：来自军方的证据
articles.abstract_en: We assess the relationship between the racial diversity of medical providers and racial health disparities in the use of preventive care and in patient outcomes. We use unique data from the Military Health System, where we observe providers as patients so that we can identify their race, and where moves across bases change exposure to provider race in a plausibly exogenous fashion. We consider patients with four chronic, deadly, but manageable illnesses, where the relationship with the provider may have the most direct impact on health. We find striking evidence that provider racial diversity leads to reduced disparities in maintenance of preventive care and mortality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估医疗服务提供者的种族多样性与预防性护理使用和患者结果方面的种族健康差异之间的关系。我们使用来自军事卫生系统的独特数据，在该系统中，我们将提供者视为患者，以便我们能够识别他们的种族，并且跨基地的流动以一种看似合理的外生方式改变了提供者种族的暴露程度。我们考虑患有四慢性、致命但可控制疾病的患者，其中与提供者的关系可能对健康产生最直接的影响。我们发现惊人的证据表明，提供者的种族多样性可以减少维持预防性护理和死亡率方面的差异。

articles.title_en: Counterfactual Identification and Latent Space Enumeration in Discrete Outcome Models
articles.title_cn: 离散结果模型中的反事实识别和潜在空间枚举
articles.abstract_en: This article provides a unified framework for studying the identification of counterfactual parameters in a general class of discrete outcome models, allowing for endogenous regressors and multidimensional latent variables, all without parametric distributional assumptions. Our main theoretical result is that, when the covariates are discrete, the infinite-dimensional latent variable distribution can be replaced with a finite-dimensional version that is equivalent from an identification perspective. The finite-dimensional latent variable distribution is constructed in practice by enumerating regions of the latent variable space with a new and efficient cell enumeration algorithm for hyperplane arrangements. We then show that bounds on a certain class of counterfactual parameters can be computed by solving a sequence of linear programming problems, and show how the researcher can introduce additional assumptions as constraints in the linear programmes. Finally, we apply the method to a mobile phone choice example with heterogeneous choice sets, and to an airline entry game example.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个统一的框架，用于研究一般类离散结果模型中反事实参数的识别，允许内生回归量和多维潜在变量，所有这些都没有参数分布假设。我们的主要理论结果是，当协变量是离散的时，无限维潜变量分布可以用从识别角度等效的有限维版本代替。在实践中，通过使用一种新的、高效的超平面排列单元枚举算法枚举潜变量空间区域来构造有限维潜变量分布。然后，我们展示了可以通过解决一系列线性规划问题来计算某类反事实参数的界限，并展示研究人员如何在线性规划中引入额外的假设作为约束。最后，我们将该方法应用于具有异构选择集的手机选择示例以及航空公司进入游戏示例。

articles.title_en: Bewley Banks
articles.abstract_en: How do movements in the distributions of bank size and income affect the macroeconomy? To answer this question, we develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous financial intermediaries, incomplete markets, and aggregate uncertainty. We find that market incompleteness and uninsured idiosyncratic bank rate of return risk generate minimal concentration in the bank net worth distribution, leading to an “as-if” result, whereby the economy behaves as if it had a representative bank. However, introducing ex ante heterogeneity in the banks’ rates of return significantly raises concentration and amplifies real and financial fluctuations relative to the representative-bank case, as this increases a key sufficient statistic, the average marginal propensity to lend. We then extend the model with two empirically validated features of the banking sector—countercyclical return risk and deposit market power—and show that these amplify and dampen aggregate fluctuations, respectively. Finally, because in the model with ex ante heterogeneity the distribution of bank size is highly concentrated, shocks to the largest banks can account for almost all of the aggregate variation that is due to idiosyncratic risk, leading to granular banking and economic cycles. The failure of granular banks (“too big to fail”) produces sizeable macroeconomic crises.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行规模和收入分布的变动如何影响宏观经济？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了一个具有异构金融中介、不完全市场和总体不确定性的动态一般均衡模型。我们发现，市场的不完整性和未投保的特殊银行回报率风险导致银行净值分布的集中程度最低，从而导致“假设”结果，即经济表现得就像有一家代表性银行一样。然而，在银行回报率中引入事前异质性会显着提高集中度，并放大相对于代表性银行案例的实际波动和金融波动，因为这增加了一个关键的充分统计数据，即平均边际贷款倾向。然后，我们用二经过实证验证的银行业特征——反周期回报风险和存款市场力量——来扩展该模型，并表明这些特征分别会放大和抑制总波动。最后，由于在事前异质性模型中，银行规模的分布高度集中，因此对最大银行的冲击可以解释几乎所有由特殊风险引起的总体变化，从而导致银行业和经济周期的细化。颗粒银行的倒闭（“太大而不能倒闭”）会产生相当大的宏观经济危机。

articles.title_en: The Micro and Macro Effects of Changes in the Potential Benefit Duration
articles.title_cn: 潜在受益期限变化的微观和宏观影响
articles.abstract_en: We quantify micro and macro effects of changes in the potential benefit duration (PBD) in unemployment insurance. In Poland, the PBD is 12 months for the newly unemployed if the previous year’s county unemployment rate is more than 150% of the national average, and 6 months otherwise. We exploit this cut-off using regression discontinuity estimates on registry data containing the universe of unemployed from 2005 to 2019. For those whose PBD is directly affected by the policy rule, benefit recipients younger than 50, a PBD increase from 6 to 12 months leads to 13% higher unemployment. A decomposition analysis reveals that 12 months after an increase in the PBD, only half of the increase in unemployment is due to the effect on search effort (the micro effect) while the other half is due to increased inflows into unemployment. The total effect on unemployment, which includes equilibrium effects, is entirely explained by the increase in unemployment of workers directly affected by the policy change. We find no evidence of spill-overs on two distinct groups of unemployed whose PBD is unchanged and no effect on measures of labour market tightness.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化失业保险潜在福利期限（PBD）变化的微观和宏观影响。在波兰，如果上一年县失业率超过全国平均水平的 12，新失业人员的 PBD 为 150% 个月，否则为 6 个月。我们利用对包含 2005 到 2019 失业人群的登记数据的回归不连续性估计来利用这一截止点。对于那些 PBD 直接受政策规则影响的人，即年龄小于 50 的受益人，PBD 从 6 增加到 12 个月会导致 13% 更高的失业率。分解分析表明，在 PBD 增加 12 个月后，失业增加中只有一半是由于对搜索工作的影响（微观效应），而另一半是由于失业流入增加。对失业的总影响（包括均衡效应）完全可以用受政策变化直接影响的工人失业增加来解释。我们没有发现任何证据表明对二不同失业群体的PBD没有变化的溢出效应，并且对劳动力市场紧张程度没有影响。

articles.title_en: Estimating Welfare Effects in a Non-Parametric Choice Model: The Case of School Vouchers
articles.title_cn: 估计非参数选择模型中的福利效应：学券案例
articles.abstract_en: We develop new robust discrete choice tools to learn about the average willingness to pay for a price subsidy and its effects on demand given exogenous, discrete variation in prices. Our starting point is a non-parametric, non-separable model of choice. We exploit the insight that our welfare parameters in this model can be expressed as functions of demand for the different alternatives. However, while the variation in the data reveals the value of demand at the observed prices, the parameters generally depend on its values beyond these prices. We show how to sharply characterize what we can learn when demand is specified to be entirely non-parametric or to be parametrized in a flexible manner, both of which imply that the parameters are not necessarily point identified. We use our tools to analyse the welfare effects of price subsidies provided by school vouchers in the DC Opportunity Scholarship Program. We find that the provision of the status quo voucher and a wide range of counterfactual vouchers of different amounts can have positive and potentially large benefits net of costs. The positive effect can be explained by the popularity of low-tuition schools in the programme; removing them from the programme can result in a negative net benefit. We also find that various standard logit specifications, in comparison, limit attention to demand functions with low demand for the voucher, which do not capture the large magnitudes of benefits credibly consistent with the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了新的稳健的离散选择工具，以了解支付价格补贴的平均意愿及其在价格外生离散变化的情况下对需求的影响。我们的出发点是选择一个非参数、不可分离的模型。我们利用这样的见解：该模型中的福利参数可以表示为不同替代方案的需求函数。然而，虽然数据的变化揭示了观察价格下的需求价值，但参数通常取决于这些价格之外的需求价值。我们展示了当需求被指定为完全非参数化或以灵活的方式参数化时，如何清晰地描述我们可以学到的东西，这两者都意味着参数不一定是点识别的。我们使用我们的工具来分析 DC 机会奖学金计划中学校优惠券提供的价格补贴的福利影响。我们发现，提供现状凭证和各种不同金额的反事实凭证可以带来积极且潜在的巨大收益（扣除成本后）。积极效果可以通过该计划中低学费学校的受欢迎程度来解释；将它们从计划中删除可能会导致净收益为负。相比之下，我们还发现各种标准 Logit 规范限制了对优惠券需求较低的需求函数的关注，而这些需求函数无法捕获与数据可信一致的大量收益。

articles.title_en: A Walrasian Mechanism with Markups for Nonconvex Markets
articles.title_cn: 非凸市场加价的瓦尔拉斯机制
articles.abstract_en: We introduce markup equilibrium—an extension of Walrasian equilibrium in which consumers pay a fixed percentage markup over producer prices. In quasilinear markets, markup equilibria exist despite nonconvexities. They are resource-feasible and envy-free, incur no budget deficit, and require little more communication and computation than ordinary Walrasian equilibrium. The associated markup mechanism is asymptotically incentive-compatible. We also introduce a Bound-Form First Welfare Theorem, which states that for any feasible allocation, the welfare loss compared to the first-best is bounded, using any price vector, by the sum of the resulting (i) budget surplus and (ii) rationing losses suffered by the participants. Using producer prices, this bound implies that any markup equilibrium with a small markup and few unallocated goods is nearly efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入加价均衡——瓦尔拉斯均衡的延伸，其中消费者支付比生产者价格固定百分比的加价。在拟线性市场中，尽管存在非凸性，但加价均衡仍然存在。它们资源可行、无嫉妒，不会产生预算赤字，并且比普通的瓦尔拉斯均衡需要更多的沟通和计算。相关的加价机制是渐近激励兼容的。我们还引入了有界形式第一福利定理，该定理指出，对于任何可行的分配，使用任何价格向量，与第一最佳分配相比，福利损失受到由此产生的（i）预算盈余和（ii）参与者遭受的配给损失之和的限制。使用生产者价格，这个界限意味着任何具有小加价和少量未分配商品的加价均衡几乎是有效的。

articles.title_en: Homeownership, Polarization, and Inequality
articles.title_cn: 住房拥有率、两极分化和不平等
articles.abstract_en: Why are job polarization and income inequality higher in large U.S. cities? I offer a new explanation: when house prices grow faster in large cities, middle-income households increasingly cannot afford to own a house there. They move to smaller cities and the middle of the income distribution in large cities hollows out, making them more polarized and unequal. I document that (1) cities with higher price growth experienced larger polarization and increase in inequality since 1980 and (2) middle-income households migrate more often to cheaper locations for housing-related reasons than low- or high-income households. Using a spatial equilibrium model with tenure choice and skill heterogeneity, I find that excess growth of prices relative to incomes and rents in large cities accounts for nearly all of the gap in polarization and almost one-half of the gap in inequality growth between large and small cities from 1980 to 2019.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么美国大城市的就业两极分化和收入不平等更加严重？ I offer a new explanation: when house prices grow faster in large cities, middle-income households increasingly cannot afford to own a house there.他们搬到较小的城市，大城市收入分配的中间部分被掏空，使他们更加两极分化和不平等。 I document that (1) cities with higher price growth experienced larger polarization and increase in inequality since 1980 and (2) middle-income households migrate more often to cheaper locations for housing-related reasons than low- or high-income households. Using a spatial equilibrium model with tenure choice and skill heterogeneity, I find that excess growth of prices relative to incomes and rents in large cities accounts for nearly all of the gap in polarization and almost 一-half of the gap in inequality growth between large and small cities from 1980 to 2019.

articles.title_en: Reallocative Auctions and Core Selection
articles.title_cn: 重新分配拍卖和核心选择
articles.abstract_en: When selling goods like wireless spectrum or electricity contracts, designers often opt for core-selecting mechanisms—i.e. those that induce outcomes in the core—in order to balance revenue and efficiency goals. But increasingly, auctions—such as the Federal Communications Commission’s Incentive Auction and those explored for natural resources—seek to reallocate goods, not just sell them. We show that when bidders can both buy and sell, substitutability among goods is no longer sufficient or necessary for core selection. In particular, in these environments, core selection can fail even with a single good and positive revenue, and can succeed even when some or all bidders view goods as complements. Instead, we show that the key feature that determines core selection is heterogeneity among the bidders. With too much heterogeneity, reallocation mostly realises pre-existing gains from trade among the bidders, and core selection fails. With limited heterogeneity, most gains from trade among the bidders are created by the quantity auctioned, and a core-selecting mechanism is possible.
articles.abstract_cn: 在销售无线频谱或电力合同等商品时，设计者通常会选择核心选择机制，即那些在核心中产生结果的方法——以平衡收入和效率目标。 But increasingly, auctions—such as the Federal Communications Commission’s Incentive Auction and those explored for natural resources—seek to reallocate goods, not just sell them.我们表明，当投标人既可以购买也可以出售时，商品之间的可替代性对于核心选择来说不再是充分或必要的。 In particular, in these environments, core selection can fail even with a single good and positive revenue, and can succeed even when some or all bidders view goods as complements.相反，我们表明决定核心选择的关键特征是投标人之间的异质性。由于异质性太大，重新分配大多实现了投标人之间交易的既有收益，核心选择失败。 With limited heterogeneity, most gains from trade among the bidders are created by the quantity auctioned, and a core-selecting mechanism is possible.

articles.title_en: The Geography of Business Dynamism and Skill-Biased Technical Change
articles.title_cn: 商业动态的地理和以技能为导向的技术变革
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that the growing disparities between big and small cities in the U.S. since 1980 can be explained by firms endogenously responding to a skill-biased technology shock. With the introduction of a new skill-biased technology that is high fixed cost but low marginal cost, firms endogenously adopt more in big cities, cities that offer abundant amenities for high-skilled workers, and cities that are more productive in using high-skilled labour. In cities with more adoption, small and unproductive firms are more likely to exit the market, increasing the equilibrium rate of turnover or business dynamism—a selection effect similar to Melitz (2003). Differences in technology adoption and selection account for three key components of the growing regional disparities, known as the Great Divergence: (1) big cities saw a larger increase in the relative wages and supply of skilled workers, (2) big cities saw a smaller decline in business dynamism, and (3) firms in big cities invest more intensively in information and communication technology.
articles.abstract_cn: This paper shows that the growing disparities between big and small cities in the U.S. since 1980 can be explained by firms endogenously responding to a skill-biased technology shock.随着固定成本高但边际成本低的偏向技能的新技术的引入，企业会在大城市、为高技能工人提供丰富便利设施的城市以及在使用高技能劳动力方面效率更高的城市内生地采用更多技术。 In cities with more adoption, small and unproductive firms are more likely to exit the market, increasing the equilibrium rate of turnover or business dynamism—a selection effect similar to Melitz (2003). Differences in technology adoption and selection account for 三 key components of the growing regional disparities, known as the Great Divergence: (1) big cities saw a larger increase in the relative wages and supply of skilled workers, (2) big cities saw a smaller decline in business dynamism, and (3) firms in big cities invest more intensively in information and communication technology.
